core-types.description: createSemanticId() and createTraceId() use time/UUID sources and are not deterministic replay primitives.
core-types.workaround: Capture generated IDs in replay evidence or supply fixed IDs in deterministic fixtures.

core-types.description: runtimeSchema() wraps a caller-supplied type guard; it does not derive schemas automatically.
core-types.workaround: Provide explicit guards and conformance tests for external inputs.

provenance.description: InMemoryProvenanceStore has no durable persistence or transaction log.
provenance.workaround: Persist snapshots in a downstream storage adapter with independent integrity controls.

provenance.description: The base store records trust metadata but does not itself prove ancestry or prevent trust escalation.
provenance.workaround: Use verifier-core provenance/trust checks before treating provenance as authoritative evidence.
